verdict.rationale: The registration overview mentions registering for a BN and program accounts "on one form" (cra-docs-6). It also lists electronic "Submit documents" as one of several submission routes (cra-docs-7), which implies a non-online form path exists. However, the evidence never names the form, the mailing address, or a fax number. missing for 10: named paper form (e.g. form number), exact mailing addresses, fax numbers, explicit documentation of the offline fallback procedure, independent corroboration.
